post.description: Create a new `CodeVerification` record and sends the code to the specified identifier. The code verification can be used to verify the given identifier. Once the interaction already carries a subject (the subject pinned by a step-up authentication, or an identified user), the identifier may carry only its `type`: the code is then sent to that user's primary email or phone with the `SignIn` template, the subject is read from the interaction storage, and the request never carries a raw identifier. This variant is only accepted with the `SignIn` interaction event.

identifier.description: The identifier (email address or phone number) to send the verification code to. Once the interaction carries a subject, `{ "type": "email" }` or `{ "type": "phone" }` without a `value` sends the code to that user's primary email or phone.

404.description: The identifier carried only its type but the interaction carries no subject, or the subject has no primary identifier of that type (`session.identifier_not_found`).

post.description: Verify the provided verification code against the user's identifier. If successful, the verification record will be marked as verified. For a code sent to the subject the interaction carries (an identifier with only its `type`), the identifier likewise carries only its `type`: the code is verified against the identifier the record was sent to, and the request never carries a raw identifier.

identifier.description: The identifier (email address or phone number) to verify the code against. Must match the identifier used to send the verification code. For a code sent to the subject the interaction carries, only the `type` is given.

404.description: Verification record not found, or the identifier carried only its type but the interaction carries no subject or the record was not created for the subject.
